Method of Attack: Trojanized module for the Barracuda SMTP daemon (bsmtpd) to upload or download arbitrary files, execute commands, proxy and tunnel malicious traffic
x64 ELF backdoor offering persistence capabilities activated by a magic packet
Lua-based module for bsmtpd to establish reverse shells via SMTP HELO/EHLO commands sent via the malware's command-and-control (C2) server
Indicators of Compromise: Malware strains identified: SALTWATER, SEASPY, SEASIDE
